# Get list of all labels (since some texts have more than one)
all_labels = [label.lower() for sublist in topic_labels for label in sublist]

# Count frequency of each label
label_counts = Counter(all_labels)

# Convert to a DataFrame for display
label_df = pd.DataFrame.from_dict(label_counts, orient='index', columns=['Frequency']).sort_index()
label_df.index.name = 'Topic'
label_df.reset_index(inplace=True)
print(label_df)

year_topics = {}

for year in years:
  temp_df = df[df['Year']==year]

  year_topics_list = temp_df['topics']

  # Get list of all labels (since some texts have more than one)
  all_labels = [label.lower() for sublist in year_topics_list for label in sublist]

  # Count frequency of each label
  label_counts = Counter(all_labels)

  top_20 = label_counts.most_common(20)

  year_topics[str(year)] = top_20

# create year groups
def yeargroup(year):
  if year < 2008:
    return 2008
  if year == 2020:
    return 2019
  return year

df['year_group'] = df['Year'].apply(yeargroup)

# plot count of talks per year
talk_count = df.groupby("year_group")['talk_id'].size().reset_index()

plt.bar(x="year_group", height='talk_id', data=talk_count)

plt.xlabel("Recorded Year")
plt.show()

df['full_text'] = df['title'] + df['description'] + df['transcript']





















In [ ]:






texts = df['full_text'].tolist()

def spacy_preprocess(doc_text):

    doc_text= nlp_processor(doc_text)

    tokens = []

    # Loop through tokens
    for token in doc_text:
        if token.is_stop:  # Skip stopwords
            continue
        lemma = token.lemma_.lower()

        if lemma.isalpha() and lemma.isascii() and len(lemma) > 2:
           tokens.append(lemma)

    return tokens

tokens = [spacy_preprocess(text) for text in texts]





















In [ ]:






dictionary = corpora.Dictionary(tokens)

dictionary.filter_extremes(no_below=20, # Remove tokens that appear in less than 20 texts
                           no_above=0.4) # Remove tokens that appear in more than 40% of texts

# Create bag-of-words corpus
bow_corpus = [dictionary.doc2bow(text) for text in tokens]





















In [ ]:






# Create empty dataframe
dtm_df = pd.DataFrame(0, index=range(len(bow_corpus)), columns=dictionary.values())

# Fill in counts by looping through words in each document
for doc_idx, doc in enumerate(bow_corpus):
    for word_id, count in doc:
        dtm_df.at[doc_idx, dictionary[word_id]] = count

print(dtm_df.shape)

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def model_coherence(num_topics, corpus):
    model = models.LdaMulticore(corpus=corpus,
                                id2word=dictionary,
                                num_topics=num_topics,
                                passes=30,
                                iterations=400,
                                random_state=123)
    cm = CoherenceModel(model=model, texts=transcript_tokens, dictionary=dictionary, coherence='c_v')
    return model, cm.get_coherence()

topic_range = list(range(5, 25, 5))  #List of topics to try out (e.g., 5, 10...25)
coherences = []
lda_models = []
# Loop through number of topics to extract
for k in topic_range:
    # Run the model and get coherence
    m, c = model_coherence(k, transcript_bow)
    lda_models.append(m)
    coherences.append(c)
    print(f"Model with {k} topics has coherence of {c}")

plt.plot(topic_range, coherences, marker='o')
plt.xlabel("num_topics")
plt.ylabel("c_v coherence")
plt.show()

Model with 25 topics has coherence of 0.4933104545299102
